paper_title: Efficient interface modification via multi-site coordination for improved efficiency and stability in organic solar cells

knowledge_points.content: 1-DPAQ (1-((3-(dimethylamino)propyl)amino)anthracene-9,10-dione) is a water/alcohol soluble anthraquinone derivative designed with multiple coordination sites (carbonyl oxygens and amine nitrogens) to passivate SnO2 surface defects.
knowledge_points.evidence: Here, a strategy for multi-site coordination was adopted by designing and introducing an anthraquinone derivative (1-DPAQ) to passivate the surface defects of SnO2 ETLs.

knowledge_points.content: The binary organic solar cell based on PM6:BTP-eC9 with a SnO2/1-DPAQ composite ETL achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 17.7%, with a Voc of 0.85 V, Jsc of 26.6 mA/cm², and FF of 78.3%.
knowledge_points.evidence: the OSC device based on binary... active layer can obtain high PCEs of 17.7%... with a higher JSC of 26.6 mA cm−2 and an enhanced FF value of 78.3%.

knowledge_points.content: A ternary organic solar cell using PM6:PB2F:BTP-eC9 (0.8:0.2:1.2) and a SnO2/1-DPAQ ETL reached a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 18.1%.
knowledge_points.evidence: the application of SnO2/1-DPAQ composite ETL in ternary devices based on PM6 : PB2F : BTP-eC9 (0.8 : 0.2 : 1.2) yielded a high PCE of 18.1%.

knowledge_points.content: Modifying the SnO2 ETL with 1-DPAQ reduces the work function from 4.36 eV to 4.17 eV, which improves energy level alignment and reduces the charge transport barrier at the cathode interface.
knowledge_points.evidence: the WFs of SnO2 and 1-DPAQ layers are 4.36 and 3.79 eV, respectively. After being modified by 1-DPAQ, the WF of the composite ETL is effectively reduced to 4.17 eV.

knowledge_points.content: The modification of SnO2 with 1-DPAQ increases the ETL conductivity from 1.81 × 10⁻³ S/m to 2.12 × 10⁻³ S/m due to the defect-filling effect.
knowledge_points.evidence: The conductivity of the bare SnO2 is 1.81 × 10−3 S m−1... the device based on the SnO2/1-DPAQ composite ETL shows... an improved conductivity of 2.12 × 10−3 S m−1.

knowledge_points.content: Density functional theory (DFT) calculations using VASP show that 1-DPAQ forms a stable double-coordination configuration with Sn atoms on the SnO2 surface via β-N and β-O sites, with a combination energy of -33.76 kcal/mol.
knowledge_points.evidence: double-coordination with different Sn atoms formed by β-N and β-O is achieved in the optimized configurations. It delivers a slightly larger combination energy of -33.76 kcal mol−1.

knowledge_points.content: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) reveals that the Sn 3d peaks in SnO2 shift to lower binding energy by 0.70 eV upon 1-DPAQ modification, indicating the formation of Sn-N bonds.
knowledge_points.evidence: the Sn 3d3/2 and Sn 3d5/2 peaks of the SnO2/1-DPAQ film... were shifted to the low binding energy direction by 0.70 eV. It can be attributed to the Sn–N bonds replacing part of the Sn–O bonds.

knowledge_points.content: The introduction of 1-DPAQ increases the water contact angle (WCA) of the ETL from 8.2° to 35.7°, suggesting that hydrophobic groups of 1-DPAQ align upward, which protects the interface from moisture.
knowledge_points.evidence: the WCA of SnO2 and 1-DPAQ are 8.2° and 8.6°, respectively. After being coated with 1-DPAQ, the WCA of the composite ETL is significantly enhanced to 35.7°.

knowledge_points.content: The SnO2/1-DPAQ modified device exhibits a higher exciton dissociation probability (Pdiss) of 93.4% compared to 90.5% for the pristine SnO2 device.
knowledge_points.evidence: The Pdiss of the inverted OSC based on SnO2/1-DPAQ is 93.4%, which is obviously higher than that of bare SnO2 with 90.5%.

knowledge_points.content: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) shows that the surface resistance of the OSC device decreases from 67.59 Ω (pristine SnO2) to 41.29 Ω (SnO2/1-DPAQ), indicating reduced interfacial charge recombination.
knowledge_points.evidence: The surface resistance of the devices with SnO2 and SnO2/1-DPAQ was determined to 67.59 and 41.29 Ω, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: Unpackaged OSC devices using the SnO2/1-DPAQ ETL maintained 97.9% of their initial PCE after 2000 hours of storage in a N2-filled glovebox, compared to 82.2% for the pristine SnO2 device.
knowledge_points.evidence: the PCE of the OSC based on SnO2/1-DPAQ showed a slow loss during storage, and it could still maintain 97.9% of the original value after storage for 2000 h.

knowledge_points.content: Under continuous illumination for 370 hours, the SnO2/1-DPAQ-based OSC device retained 59.3% of its initial PCE, whereas the control SnO2-based device retained only 13.7%.
knowledge_points.evidence: The PCE of the SnO2/1-DPAQ-based device maintained 59.3% of the initial PCE, while the SnO2-based device accounted for only 13.7% of the initial PCE.
